items.question: What inscription must be written there to include the target's name and the specified seed-syllables?
premises: The previously prepared surface is the place for the inscription.
The inscription must include the target's name.
The inscription must include the pair of seed-syllables hrīṃ and klīṃ.
items.inference: One should write on that surface the target's name together with the pair of seed-syllables hrīṃ and klīṃ.
items.plain_english: There one should write the target's name together with the pair of seed-syllables hrīṃ and klīṃ.
